text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Autograph boards and pens... Alright, 
everything is in order. 
...Hm?"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah... Duramente-san...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Are you out shopping as well?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Ugh, I can't keep the conversation 
going...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Um... Is the autograph session... 
going to go well...?"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"............ 
It must go well. It is my duty."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Duty?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"My father, my grandfather... Generation 
after generation, my family has been 
supported by many fans, and has 
magnificently lived up to their 
expectations."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"I must do the same. 
I must be able to... provide fan service 
as well."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...I see. You're amazing, Duramente-san. 
I... I'm just desperately trying not to 
let anyone down, so..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (HONKKK!! CLATTER-BANG-BOOM!!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Wh-what's that noise...?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ――Bravissimo!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"A Buon Anno melody performed together by 
us and our fans...! 
Ah, that sound will surely drive away the 
north wind and set my soul ablaze...!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, yeah, we get how passionate you 
are. 
Still, you rushed back from visiting home 
and you're already raring to go, huh."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Naturally! To play an ensemble for the 
New Year's da capo, 
I simply could not stay silent!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"A band, huh. A band. 
...Honestly, I'm not even sure we can call 
this a band."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"If we, the performers, say it is, then 
it's a band! 
Yes, the coolest, star attraction of any 
student festival――a 'band'!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Listen, okay? It'd be a waste to just end 
this with 'gratitude'. Sudden events draw 
a totally different crowd. This is our 
chance to win new fans!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Showing gratitude to our existing fans is 
a given. 
On top of that, an event where we can 
expect extra perks is best!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Sooo, what does that mean???

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"To put it simply: 'Let's stand out as 
much as possible!' 
We'll grab both existing fans and 
newcomers all at once!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Let's polish our image so we look strong 
yet stylish, 
making them think, 'I wanna see her 
race~!'"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"In other words... we just gotta go 
completely all-out! 
Leave it to me! Turbo's great at that!"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...What is all this commotion?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, Cheval and Duramente. 
This is, uh... band practice."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Is that... a performance for the countdown 
party?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"That's the idea, but... most of us don't 
even know the first thing about 
instruments, so it's a totally unplanned 
band, you see..."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"I told 'em forming a band just because 
it's popular is reckless, but well..."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Will that... really be all right? 
Will the fans be satisfied with――"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"I'll say it right now! Our performance is 
gonna be unlistenable! 
...However."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"――I have a feeling the fans will love it. 
Whenever we recklessly take on a 
challenge, they always get hyped up for 
us."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Even if we're not perfect, our fans tell 
us that's okay. 
For some reason, they cheer us on anyway."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Well, in any case, we've got tons of 
problems, but everyone's plenty motivated. 
By the time of the real thing, we'll at 
least make sure people can tell what song 
we're playing."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Now then, let's keep practicing! 
――One, two, three, four!"

text_block_list.name: All Three
text_block_list.text:
"Uhhhhhhhhh! Umadacchi! 
Uhhhhhhhhh! Umapyoi! Umapyoi!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
This can also technically... count as a 
'band'!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No... shouldn't we try just a little 
harder...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, as each group busied themselves 
with preparations... 
the day of the event arrived in the blink 
of an eye!"
